row.name: YouTube-Downloader
row.description: YouTube Downloader is a web-based tool that lets users download YouTube videos and audio in multiple formats and qualities, including HD and 4K. It supports video, audio-only, playlists, subtitles, and automatic merging, offering a fast, clean, and watermark-free experience.
